item.title: Portland Students Walk Out of Class to Protest ICE Activity
item.description: Lincoln High School students marched from their campus to City Hall, where they rallied against recent abductions and deaths in ICE custody. by Courtney Vaughn Lincoln High School students walked out of class Tuesday afternoon to rally against recent ICE activity in Portland. Roughly 80 students marched from their downtown campus to Portland City Hall, where they gathered to chant, give speeches, and observe a moment of silence for those who’ve died in ICE custody.
